_comment: A felt tent. A herding people's house: no timber frame worth the name, no stone, no thatch - poles and beaten wool, warm out of all proportion to its weight, and it can be taken down. What makes it a different way of living from a hut is that its materials come off the flock rather than out of the country (D100).
name: felt_tent
label: Felt tent

_comment: A smokehouse: a hut with a slow fire under hanging meat. A forest people has no grain worth storing and everything it eats walks away if it is not preserved, so this is its granary.
name: smokehouse
label: Smokehouse
